//: What rules ask of the town's day: how many people are where their routines have them, and how many are on their way.
doc: How many stand within a radius of a cell, in metres, whose routines have them doing something (`asleep`, `at_market`): how busy a place is at this hour.
How many stand within a radius of a cell, in metres, whose minds hold a goal, by its qualified id (`core:confront`): how many are fighting, fleeing or answering a call there.
How many stand within a radius of a cell, in metres, who are away from where their routines have them: on their way somewhere.
